why did i make a blog?

tldr: i was bored and this is really just a test blog post

So, basically... I wanted to make a cool little website to host my projects. But then I realised that some of those projects weren't really projects but I still wanted to share them. Thus, I made this blog!


Isn't that fun?


Anyways, I used several great technologies to accomplish this. I used Eleventy, which is a static site generator. Basically, I create a template and give it markdown files and it generates the HTML pages for me. Which is awesome, because it's much better than copy and pasting a bunch, which is what I was doing earlier.


Okay, Colin out. Yippee!
